remarks: **Incredible Price Drop! Now Available at a Stunningly Low Price - Your Dream Home in an Exclusive Private Beach Community! Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to own a slice of paradise at an unbeatable value!** Welcome home to this beautiful coastal community, Village Creek. Enjoy access to a gorgeous private beach, marina, playground & tennis courts. In a lovely private setting, this home comprises an open contemporary spacious floor plan. Enter into the bright living room with fireplace, dining area is illuminated with skylight. The kitchen is beautifully updated with new appliances. 5/6 bright and spacious bedrooms on main level presents private views of the grounds and 1 with sliders to deck which could also be cozy family room/office, laundry closet. Master suite is on 2nd floor with additional room, walk in closet & full bath. Features include a gorgeous oversized deck for those al-fresco dining moments, incredible sunsets.  Minutes to the state's coolest neighborhood South Norwalk Historic District offering high end SoNo Mall, superb dining, Maritime Center, entertainment. Easy access to trains and major commuter highways & freeways. Sold As Is
